stem: [制裁合规与筛查]哪些措施有助于确保名称筛查流程能够有效识别潜在风险？(选择三项.)

options.A: 在政策和程序中明确界定筛查范围、频率以及警报裁决流程
options.B: 确定行业内最常用的姓名筛查数据库
options.C: 指定专人确保筛查控制措施得到一致实施
options.D: 进行风险评估,以确定要筛选的数据属性、筛选频率以及数据库的选择.
options.E: 定期进行测试,以验证筛查系统是否按预期运行

stem_en: Which measures help ensure that the name screening process is effective in identifying potential risk? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Define in policies and procedures the screening scope, frequency, and alert adjudication process.
options_en.B: Identify the most commonly used name screening database in the industry.
options_en.C: Assign a designated person to ensure consistent implementation of screening controls.
options_en.D: Conduct a risk assessment to determine which data attributes to screen, screening frequency, and database selection.
options_en.E: Conduct periodic testing to validate whether the screening system is operating as intended.
